data.title: 阿米娅 · 绿植温室的水汽晨光
data.description: 晨光斜照的罗德岛生态温室，自动喷淋系统在翠绿花叶间弥散开轻盈的水汽彩虹。阿米娅穿着轻便的棉麻工装无袖短裙，赤着双足踩在温润的木质步道上，正轻轻伸展微酸的腰肢。薄薄的晨汗濡湿了鬓角碎发，她转头擦汗，在光影折射中展露出毫无防备的明媚笑颜。
data.location: humid misted greenhouse among exotic plants
data.action: stretching arms gently in sunlit greenhouse mist, sleeveless linen work dress, bare feet on wooden floor, dewy floral background, radiant blushing smile
data.lighting: brilliant morning sunbeams piercing greenhouse glass and mist
data.mood: pure sunlit freshness, innocent refreshing allure
data.promptProse: Stretching her arms in a humid, sun-drenched greenhouse, Amiya stands barefoot on a wooden path. Morning sunbeams illuminate floating water mist and blooming flowers as she turns with a bright, welcoming smile.
data.animaCaption: Amiya stretching barefoot in a sunlit greenhouse filled with mist and blooming flowers.
